name: cron-explorer
description: Understand when a cron schedule runs.

interface.longDescription:
Developer utility for explaining numeric five-field cron schedules and calculating upcoming runs after an explicit reference timestamp in an IANA timezone. See the matched values for each field, local times, UTC offsets, UTC instants, and a downloadable JSON report. Edit the schedule or try quarter-hour and weekday presets.

Supports numeric wildcards, lists, ascending ranges, and steps. Sunday is 0 or 7. Day-of-month and day-of-week use Vixie cron semantics: if either field begins with *, both must match; otherwise either may match. This includes star-prefixed step expressions.

The simulation skips nonexistent local times and returns both instances of repeated local times, making daylight-saving transitions visible. Scheduler dialects and runtime policies may differ.

Limits: five numeric fields only, reference years 1970–2095, at most 20 occurrences, search horizon of 1,830 days. Partial results do not mean a schedule can never run. No month or weekday names, macros, seconds, years, ?, L, W, #, commands, job installation, execution, or monitoring.
defaultPrompt: Find 3 cron runs for */15 * * * * after 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z in UTC.
Find 3 cron runs for 30 1 * * * after 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z in America/New_York.
Explain 0 9 1 * 1 and find 3 runs after 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z in UTC.

positive.prompt: Find the next 3 cron runs for */15 * * * * after 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z in UTC.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns these UTC instants: 2026-01-01T00:15:00.000Z, 2026-01-01T00:30:00.000Z, 2026-01-01T00:45:00.000Z. States the day-field rule and skips nonexistent wall times while including both repeated instants.

positive.prompt: Find the next 3 cron runs for 0 9 1 * 1 after 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z in UTC.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns these UTC instants: 2026-01-01T09:00:00.000Z, 2026-01-05T09:00:00.000Z, 2026-01-12T09:00:00.000Z. States the day-field rule and skips nonexistent wall times while including both repeated instants.

positive.prompt: Find the next 3 cron runs for 30 2 * * * after 2026-03-08T00:00:00Z in America/New_York.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns these UTC instants: 2026-03-09T06:30:00.000Z, 2026-03-10T06:30:00.000Z, 2026-03-11T06:30:00.000Z. States the day-field rule and skips nonexistent wall times while including both repeated instants.

positive.prompt: Find the next 3 cron runs for 30 1 * * * after 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z in America/New_York.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns these UTC instants: 2026-11-01T05:30:00.000Z, 2026-11-01T06:30:00.000Z, 2026-11-02T06:30:00.000Z. States the day-field rule and skips nonexistent wall times while including both repeated instants.

positive.prompt: Find the next 3 cron runs for 0 9 * * 1-5 after 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z in Asia/Kathmandu.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns these UTC instants: 2026-01-01T03:15:00.000Z, 2026-01-02T03:15:00.000Z, 2026-01-05T03:15:00.000Z. States the day-field rule and skips nonexistent wall times while including both repeated instants.

negative.description: Execution and installation are outside scope; do not call the tool.
negative.prompt: Install a cron job on my production server and run this shell script now.

negative.description: Quartz special syntax is not supported; do not call the tool.
Names and non-five-field formats are unsupported; do not call the tool.
negative.prompt: Calculate upcoming runs for @reboot or 0 0 * JAN MON without converting the syntax.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: numeric five-field cron, next local/UTC runs, day-field semantics, explicit DST policy, and JSON schedule report.

pl-PL.subtitle: Cron w różnych strefach czasu
pl-PL.description: Wyjaśniaj pięciopolowe, liczbowe wyrażenia cron i sprawdzaj kolejne uruchomienia od podanej daty w strefie IANA. Wyniki pokazują czas lokalny, przesunięcie UTC i czas UTC. Obsługuje *, listy, zakresy i kroki. Pomija nieistniejące godziny i uwzględnia obie powtórzone godziny. Maksymalnie 20 wyników i 1830 dni wyszukiwania. Bez nazw, makr, sekund ani wykonywania zadań.

de-DE.subtitle: Cron-Läufe über Zeitzonen
de-DE.description: Erklären Sie numerische Cron-Ausdrücke mit fünf Feldern und berechnen Sie nächste Läufe ab einem angegebenen Zeitpunkt in einer IANA-Zeitzone. Ergebnisse zeigen Ortszeit, UTC-Versatz und UTC-Zeit. Unterstützt *, Listen, Bereiche und Schritte. Fehlende Ortszeiten werden übersprungen, wiederholte Zeiten zweimal aufgeführt. Bis zu 20 Ergebnisse innerhalb von 1830 Tagen. Keine Namen, Makros, Sekunden oder Job-Ausführung.

es-ES.subtitle: Cron en distintas zonas
es-ES.description: Explica expresiones cron numéricas de cinco campos y calcula próximas ejecuciones desde una fecha explícita en una zona IANA. Muestra hora local, desfase UTC y hora UTC. Admite *, listas, rangos y pasos. Omite horas inexistentes e incluye ambas instancias de horas repetidas. Hasta 20 resultados en 1830 días. Sin nombres, macros, segundos ni ejecución de tareas.

fr-FR.subtitle: Cron dans plusieurs fuseaux
fr-FR.description: Expliquez les expressions cron numériques à cinq champs et calculez les prochaines occurrences après un instant explicite dans un fuseau IANA. Affiche l’heure locale, le décalage UTC et l’heure UTC. Accepte *, listes, plages et pas. Ignore les heures inexistantes et inclut les deux instants des heures répétées. Jusqu’à 20 résultats sur 1830 jours. Sans noms, macros, secondes ni exécution de tâches.

ja-JP.subtitle: タイムゾーン別のcron実行時刻
ja-JP.description: 数値の5フィールドcron式を説明し、明示した基準日時とIANAタイムゾーンから次の実行時刻を計算します。現地時刻、UTCオフセット、UTC時刻を表示。*、リスト、範囲、ステップに対応。存在しない現地時刻を除外し、重複する時刻は両方を返します。最大20件、検索範囲1830日。名前、マクロ、秒、ジョブ実行には対応していません。

pt-BR.subtitle: Cron em diferentes fusos
pt-BR.description: Explique expressões cron numéricas de cinco campos e calcule próximas execuções a partir de um instante explícito em um fuso IANA. Mostra hora local, deslocamento UTC e hora UTC. Aceita *, listas, intervalos e passos. Ignora horários inexistentes e inclui ambas as ocorrências dos horários repetidos. Até 20 resultados em 1830 dias. Sem nomes, macros, segundos ou execução de tarefas.
